environment: Windows Playwright; loopback Vite production preview, one worker at a time; synthetic 5000-row fixture, not missions or real devices.
method: Nearest-rank P75; five measured trials per strategy/cohort; own warm-ups excluded. Cold=fresh browser context/SW blocked, not cold OS/CPU. Warm=actual preview HTTP revalidation. Offline=explicit SW-owned verified download, all pages closed, fresh offline clients. Input event-to-next-frame is not INP; Resource Timing covers observed worker resources, not all wire traffic. PG WASM allocation is not total process peak memory; unsupported long-task observation is null.
